name: watu
description: Senior QA technical exercise with Playwright, MySQL, Flyway, Prisma and WireMock.

scripts.quality: npm run bdd:generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.db:prepare: npm run prisma:pull && npm run prisma:generate && npm run data:users && npm run data:roles
scripts.test:ui: npm run bdd:generate && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=reports/ui PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE=reports/blobs/ui.zip PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR=test-results/ui playwright test --project="UI - Desktop Chromium" --project="UI - Desktop Firefox" --project="UI - Mobile iPhone"
scripts.test:db: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=reports/db PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE=reports/blobs/database.zip PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR=test-results/database playwright test --project="DATABASE - MySQL and Prisma"
scripts.test:api: npm run bdd:generate && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=reports/api PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE=reports/blobs/api.zip PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_OUTPUT_DIR=test-results/api playwright test --project="API - WireMock"
